plan.notes: Transcribed from the official SCC 'Field Ecology Certificate - Pathway 1 (Fall Start)' program map, Catalog 2025-26, published July 19, 2025 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/6906/PublishedPdf). Start Term: Fall. Official Total Units: 24-27; this seed models the first-listed/recommended path at the low end of variable-unit ranges = 7+8+9 = 24 units. Semester sums verified against the map's 7-8 / 8-10 / 9 headers. This is a Certificate of Achievement (no GE pattern; all courses are major/major-elective). Choice slots: (1) S1 major elective (3-4, modeled at 3): BIOL 326 Ethnobotany, chosen from BIOL 321, 326, 327, 330, 332, 350, 352, 364, 370, BIOLFS 310, 311, 350, CHEM 320, GEOG 331, 334, GEOL 345 (minimum 5 units from the pool across Semesters 1-2); (2) S2 major elective (2-4, modeled at 2): BIOL 364 Restoration Ecology (2 units), same pool, not already completed; (3) S3 major elective: BIOL 412 / BIOL 422 (5 units), modeled as BIOL 412. Prereq notes from the map: BIOL 321 requires BIOL 320 (C or better); BIOL 327 requires BIOL 326 or prior completion (corequisite); BIOLFS 310 has an enrollment limitation (course application from the instructor); BIOLFS 311 requires BIOLFS 310 with a B or better (documented, not sequenced; modeled picks BIOL 326/BIOL 364 have no prerequisites). In-plan prereq sequenced: BIOL 362 requires BIOL 305 or equivalent college-level ecology course with lecture and lab (C or better) — in-plan slot BIOL 305. The BIOL 412/422 prerequisite (BIOL 402 or equivalent) is external to this certificate map and lives in external_prereqs. Two pathways exist for this certificate; this map is Pathway 1 (students pursuing the AS in Biology); Pathway 2 is a separate map. The map's counselor notes also give an alternate 2-semester spring-start sequence (documented here, not modeled). Certificates of Achievement require a grade of C or better in each major course (map note). tccns mirrors SCC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS).
